Dara (CS): Quick alert 16% drop in accepted replies for Quasar's onboarding assistant over 36h. Renewal touchpoint in 4 weeks. I suggest a low-risk pilot: route low-complexity/helpdesk intents to rdx-edge-int4 while keeping escalation/payment flows on the full model. Thoughts? :signal_strength:
Len (Eng): Seen the traces. p95 latency spikes align with long-context sessions. Small plan: 1% -> 5% ramp with checks; ensure immediate fallback and request-level diff logging.
Omar (ML): Model note: rdx-edge-int4 shows ~0.7% acceptability dip on Quasar prompts, hallucination stable. Recommend: 3% canary for 72h, nightly automated eval + 4 human spot-checks/day, prefix caching for templated prompts, and token cap fallback >750 tokens.
Len (Eng): Routing pseudo-config draft:
```
routing:
  - match: tag in ["escalation","payment"]
    target: rdx-standard-3
  - match: complexity_score < 0.35
    target: weighted(rdx-edge-int4:0.03, rdx-standard-3:0.97)
    fallback: rdx-standard-3
```
rollout-bot: Canary queued: model=rdx-edge-int4, region=us-west-2, traffic=3%, duration=72h, eval_hook=quasar_nightly_eval_v1
Dara (CS): I'll draft a short customer note explaining safeguards and schedule a 20m enablement. Owners: @Omar owns eval gating and human checks, @Len owns routing & rollback automation, I own comms + renewal update. Will report first 24h snapshot here. :white_check_mark:
